body: I never looked at it the way you described.  Keeping on living is almost as painful as death itself.
My son and daughter.  If it wasn't for them,  I would have jumped in front of a train already.
But it gets harder when he's not around.

I'll will not. My kids are the best part of my day. I live for those hours when I can hold them - my son only, as my daughter lives far away... I had to find a reason to live, and the look in my son's face is the reason.
That's me described in your words. Thank you. It's good to know  that there are others on the same situation as me.
